# Machine Learning Engineering: Tier 3: Advanced Engineering, Research and System Design

> **The question this tier answers:** Can you take on an ambiguous, substantial problem, make research-informed decisions, run rigorous experiments, and defend the trade-offs?

See [tier definitions](../../../docs/tier-definitions.md) for the full competency description, and [how to choose an assessment](../../../docs/member-handbook.md).

## Units at this tier

### ML-01: Mathematical and Computational Foundations

Linear algebra, calculus and optimisation, probability for ML, numerical stability and vectorised computation.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-02: Supervised Learning and Ensembles

Linear and kernel models, trees, bagging, boosting and stacking, plus the bias-variance trade-off, implemented and applied.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-03: Unsupervised and Representation Learning

Clustering, dimensionality reduction, density estimation, anomaly detection and learned representations.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-04: Feature Engineering and Data for ML

Encoding, leakage-safe preprocessing pipelines, feature selection, labelling quality and data-centric ML.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-05: Evaluation, Validation and Model Selection

Metric choice, cross-validation design, calibration, statistical comparison of models and hyperparameter search.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-06: Neural Networks and Deep Learning

Backpropagation from first principles, training dynamics, regularisation, architectures and PyTorch engineering.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-07: Computer Vision

Image processing, CNNs, transfer learning, detection and segmentation basics, robustness and failure analysis.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-08: Natural Language Processing

Tokenisation, classical and neural text models, transformers, low-resource and African-language NLP.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-09: Time-Series Machine Learning

Lag features, leakage-free temporal validation, global models, sequence models and anomaly detection on streams.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-10: Recommender and Ranking Systems

Collaborative filtering, matrix factorisation, implicit feedback, ranking metrics and offline evaluation pitfalls.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-11: Efficient ML and Model Optimization

Profiling, quantisation, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and latency/memory budgets on CPU hardware.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-12: Model Deployment and Serving

Model packaging, REST serving, containers, input validation, batch versus online inference and load testing.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-13: ML Pipelines, MLOps and Monitoring

Experiment tracking, reproducible pipelines, CI for ML, model registries, drift detection and retraining policy.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._

### ML-14: Responsible ML (Fairness, Interpretability and Robustness)

Fairness metrics and trade-offs, explainability methods and their limits, adversarial and distributional robustness, model cards.

_Assessments for this unit are in development._
